description: Java interface defining methods for processing portfolio commands related to logging, approving, rejecting, and deleting entries within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: PortfolioCommandSourceWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for handling portfolio command requests, approvals, rejections, and deletions.

methods.name: logCommandSource
methods.description: Logs a command source request encapsulated in a CommandWrapper object.

methods.name: approveEntry
methods.description: Approves an entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: rejectEntry
methods.description: Rejects an entry specified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry using its maker-checker ID.
